primaryReference.wholePageRelationships: Dark visual workbench: one dominant stage plus narrow evidence rail, category-photo-plus-list catalogue, factual visit index. Typography spans the whole opening before images.

supplementalReferences.problem: Vary image scale and juxtaposition without another symmetric photo-text split

sections.mechanism: Dominant coffee image with secondary image navigation, all within one dark stage
sections.adaptation: Oversized heavy sans sits above coffee rather than covering food; breakfast and brewing form evidence rail
sections.rejected: Serif type, sushi assets, pill navigation, complex corner cutouts
sections.mobile: Masthead then coffee stage then paired small rail; no split hero stacking

sections.mechanism: Large category photo accompanies close name-price list
sections.adaptation: 20-category Base UI sidebar; category photos remain correctly attributed group photos; 8-result replacing pagination
sections.rejected: Tiny repeated thumbnails when only category photo exists; sticky full-height image
sections.mobile: Plain category tabs and expanding search; category photo above compact results

sections.mechanism: Unequal image scales and dense information index instead of repeated equal split scenes
sections.adaptation: One small brewing view, factual address rows, broad facade/map composition
sections.rejected: Invented editorial articles, dates, stats and hospitality claims
sections.mobile: Address and actions before full-width map; smaller process image shares heading row

comparison.closestDemo: Previous Talkie; Classico dark source palette may remain similar
structuralDifferences: Full-width masthead above image matrix, no left-copy/right-photo hero
exceptions: Brand black/white and DM Sans preserved; palette cannot establish distinction
